node_icu_data.description: Path to the directory containing ICU data files for internationalization support.

node_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories where Node.js will look for modules.

node_options.description: Space-separated list of command-line options to pass to Node.js on startup.

uv_threadpool_size.description: Number of threads in the libuv thread pool. Affects asynchronous file system and network I/O.

force_color.description: Forces color output. Empty string uses default behavior. '1', '2', or '3' for specific color depths.

node_extra_ca_certs.description: Path to a PEM file containing additional trusted CA certificates.

node_tls_reject_unauthorized.description: Set to '0' to disable TLS certificate verification. Leave empty to use system defaults.

tz.description: Timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'UTC') for the Node.js process.
